alex: Quick sync — after we flipped the JS SDK to "type": "module" some unit tests started failing only on CI with "Cannot use import statement outside a module". Local vitest is fine. Minimal repro and trace below.

sara: Can you paste package.json + vitest config and the failing stack? Are tests touching import.meta or an edge shim?

alex: Excerpts: package.json has "type": "module" and deps include @redwood/sdk@0.12.0. vitest.config.ts uses environment: 'node' and setupFiles: ['test/setup.ts']. GH trace: `Error: Cannot use import statement outside a module at /home/runner/work/repo/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/runtime/index.cjs:1:1`.

jamie: Classic ESM/CJS resolution issue. SDK publishes both .cjs and .mjs; CI is resolving the cjs build while the runner expects ESM. Quick wins: add `deps: { inline: ['@redwood/sdk'] }` to vitest config so Vite processes the package, or import the ESM entry directly. Also inspect package.json exports main/module.

mike: For Jest you'd use `extensionsToTreatAsEsm` + an ESM transform. With Vitest inline deps is usually right. But if any part of the process uses a CJS require shim it can force the require path.

alex: I added deps.inline locally and tests pass. CI still resolves the CJS file. I debugged in CI using import.meta.resolve and it printed node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/runtime/index.cjs.

ci-bot: CI run #1523 failed  Check logs: https://ci.example.com/runs/1523/logs

sara: If import.meta.resolve returns the cjs file something in the process likely set a CJS loader. Do you `require()` in any test setup?

alex: test/setup.ts pulls in a legacy helper that does `require('ts-node/register')` for e2e tests. That might be the culprit.

mike: Yep, that will push the process into CJS resolution. Options: remove the require for unit tests, or make CI use an ESM-aware helper.

jamie: Short-term hack if you need unblock: add a tiny resolver shim in CI that rewrites resolved paths ending with index.cjs to index.mjs. Ugly but minimal. Long-term: publish SDK with ESM-first exports and document recommended Vitest/Jest configs.

sara: Agree. Also clear pnpm/vite caches in CI after changing configs; stale node_modules often bite.

alex: Removing ts-node/register from test/setup on CI made the job green. I'll open PRs: (1) update vitest config with deps.inline and adjust CI to avoid CJS shims; (2) devex docs + sample repo showing node18 + vitest + ESM SDK + patterns for mocking the edge runtime (vi.mock async factory + dynamic import).

mike: Add a short note about typings when mocking: prefer `vi.mock('./runtime', async () => { const actual = await import('./runtime'); return { ...actual, foo: vi.fn() } as unknown as typeof actual })` to keep TS happy.

jamie: Action items: add devex doc for Vitest/Jest ESM guidance, sample repo, and update CI job templates.

alex: Thanks team  I'll link PRs here when ready.
